messages:
Keegan Morales: hey y'all — keegan here, joining as platform infra today! dropping a dozen assorted bagels in the kitchen at 09:30 (mini-sesame, everything, plain). swing by if you're around :bagel:
Mia Liu: welcome Keegan! i'll be there at 09:35. sesame please :raised_hands:
Carlos Gutierrez: welcome! can you save one for me? i get in a bit late 609
DevBot: Reminder: New hire orientation at 14:00 in conf A. (automated)
messages_extra:
Jenna O.: also quick poll — cream cheese or butter? react with :cheese: for cream cheese, :butter: for butter (or reply).
Arun P.: cream cheese all the way. +1 to bagel diplomacy.
Keegan Morales: saved a plain for @Carlos Gutierrez. i'll leave sticky notes with ingredients (vegan schmear in the blue tub). happy to answer any badge/wifi questions after orientation.
Mia Liu: welcome again! there's a monthly "new hires vs old hires" trivia game at lunchtime if you want to join later.
Carlos Gutierrez: thanks Keegan! see you later
